title: Amiga Studio IDE 1.3.0 by Pier Shaw
excerpt: Amiga Studio is an IDE for making games and applications for the Commodore Amiga 500, Amiga 1200 and Commodore 64,
content_html:
Amiga Studio is an IDE for making games and applications for the Commodore Amiga 500, Amiga 1200 and Commodore 64, in assembler or C. You write code, press F5, and your program runs straight away in the built-in Game View: an emulated Amiga or C64 with sound, joystick, mouse and keyboard. No ROMs, no setup, no other programs needed.

  • Built-in 68000/68020 assembler (Devpac/vasm syntax), byte-for-byte identical to GNU as
  • Amiga 500 (OCS) and Amiga 1200 (AGA, 256 colours) in the Game View: copper, blitter, sprites, Paula sound, CIAs
  • C with a bare-metal GCC runtime; vbcc and amiga-gcc for OS-friendly programs
  • A component library: interrupts, screens, blitter BOBs, text, sprites, input, sound and a UI toolkit
  • Export bootable ADF floppies that run on a real Amiga, or launch WinUAE / FS-UAE / Amiberry

Commodore 64

  • Built-in 6502 assembler (ACME syntax, plus ca65 and KickAssembler styles), byte-identical to ACME
  • C with cc65, errors jump to the line and the debugger follows your C source
  • A PAL C64 in the Game View: VIC-II with raster interrupts and sprites, SID sound with filter, CIAs, keyboard and joystick
  • Export .prg files and D64 disks, or launch VICE

For both

  • Debugger: breakpoints, step, step over, registers, disassembly, chip state, a live memory map
  • Instructions, Registers and Directives menus: every opcode, hardware register and KERNAL / OS call, with examples you can insert
  • Tools: Tiled-style map editor, pixel/sprite editor, image, sound and video converters, copper gradient builder, screen designer
  • Two complete guides and full references, offline: learn the Amiga and the C64 from your first program to a finished game
  • 27 examples: Breakout, Star Catcher, scrollers, raster bars, BOBs, music players, AGA plasma, UI apps, in assembler and C

  7. BattleNoidz – https://piershaw.itch.io/battlenoidz
